name: Ren
source:
A mysterious girl whose existence is similar to [url=/c3930]Mare's[/url]. For some reason, she looks over [url=/c3907]Chinami[/url] and sometimes even does her homework. Chinami calls her "Fairy-san". She is easily amused, but gets embarrassed when somebody pats her head.

[spoiler]Ren is actually a grim reaper from another world just like Mare, and [url=/c19231]Taiga's[/url] partner. She also hung around Tenkuru's members when [url=/c6157]Mayaka[/url], [url=/c6162]Souichirou[/url] and [url=/c6160]Shino[/url] were part of it.[/spoiler]
